title: CONFIRMED LIVE — candidate comms are never delivered by default: every message this run (2 acks, 1 rejection) landed queued-terminal in the recruiter-only outbox
expected: The acknowledgement (with the status link), the rejection, and later stage comms reach the candidate on a real channel.
got: Live: Tereza's cs ack, the reject fixture's cs rejection, and Sam's en ack all recorded with status 'queued', channel 'outbox' — the documented TERMINAL dev state; .env.local carries no COMMS_WEBHOOK_URL and no mail provider exists. Seeded comms from hours earlier (offer, onboarding) sit queued too — systemic. The addressability half is actually fixed for inbound applicants: every row was addressed to the candidate's REAL captured e-mail. Candidate-facing copy still promises delivery in three places rendered this run: the quick done screens (cs 'Potvrzení jsme vám poslali e-mailem' / en 'We've emailed you a confirmation') and the status page's Interview now-line ('Jste ve fázi pohovoru — sledujte e-mail kvůli termínu' / 'watch your email for scheduling'). Mitigation held live: the conversational done card renders the status link in-page, so a candidate who saves it can pull status without any e-mail.
evidence: dev_outbox rows (read-only DB): out-mr3tqfta-d4lous acknowledgement→tereza.kralova.uat@example.com queued/outbox; rejection→martin.vondracek.uat@example.com queued/outbox; acknowledgement→sam.okafor.uat@example.com queued/outbox
.env.local — no COMMS_WEBHOOK_URL (checked 2026-07-02); app/_lib/comms.ts:36-42,97-100 ('queued' terminal; WebhookChannel only when set)
uat/runs/2026-07-02-full/shots/l2-capst-tereza-20-quick-02-done.png + l2-capst-quick-en-02-done.png (the e-mail claim rendered, both locales)
scope_note: Pluggable-channel design is deliberate and documented (docs/COMMS_DELIVERY.md); severity stays major because candidate-facing copy actively asserts delivery on surfaces rendered to real candidates.
suggested_acceptance: A real provider adapter behind the CommsChannel seam, or strip every 'we emailed you / watch your email' string until one is configured.

title: NEW (L2-only) — the GDPR erasure link in every candidate comm is a dead relative path on default config, while the status link in the same e-mail is absolute
expected: The disclosure promises 'review or request erasure of your data anytime via the link in our emails' — that link must resolve outside the app.
got: Every candidate comm captured this run (both acks, the rejection — and pre-existing seeded offer/onboarding rows) renders the GDPR footer link as a bare relative path ('/data/er-…'), unusable in any mail client. Root cause: dataFooter builds it via publicBaseUrl() with NO runtime origin; with APP_BASE_URL / NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_BASE_URL unset the helper returns '' and the 'absolute' link degrades silently. The same e-mail's status link IS absolute because the route handler passes the request origin. So the one self-service GDPR pathway the disclosure names is broken by default — even a configured relay would ship dead erasure links until the env knob is also set. The /data/[token] page itself works (see capst-l2-103).
evidence: dev_outbox bodies (all three this-run comms): 'Stav své přihlášky … zde: http://localhost:3009/status/as-…' followed by '…výmaz:\n/data/er-…' (relative)
contrast: app/api/apply/[id]/route.ts:479 (statusLink built with request origin)
same defect class visible in seeded onboarding comm: '/onboarding/tk-…' relative (dev_outbox out-mr3stuye-qv68jb)
scope_note: L1 surface-model gap: L1 verified the footer EXISTS on every comm but never resolved what publicBaseUrl() returns with nothing configured. Compounds capst-l1-001 (undelivered) and undermines the aiDisclosure.dataConsent promise at the point of consent.
suggested_acceptance: Fail loudly (or fall back to the entry's known origin) when publicBaseUrl() resolves empty for an outbound comm; document APP_BASE_URL as required for any relay deploy; one shared link-builder for ALL candidate links in a comm body.
